records.summary_text:
[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 31 July 2026.

[2026-07-31_MU]  
Video Title: Is Micron Technology (MU) Facing Mean Reversion? MU Hits 570% Premium Above Lifetime TWAP  
Video ID: 2LWOYDtw-Do  
Micron Technology (MU) | Class: EQUITY  

    Current Market Structure:  
    • The AI‑sector screen places MU in the golden breakout zone, exhibiting > median 90‑day momentum with a 106% return and 76% trend volatility, while composite risk sits below median.  
    • MU trades above its 20‑week, 50‑week, and 200‑week SMAs, indicating a breakout profile; the 20‑week SMA is near the 200‑week SMA, suggesting a consolidation phase within an uptrend.  
    • Momentum versus risk quadrant places MU in the high‑momentum, low‑risk quadrant, yet the recent 10‑week bottoming pattern signals potential accumulation pressure.  
    • Accumulation versus breakout analysis shows the stock has moved from a breakout phase into a potential mean‑reversion zone, with the 10‑week bottoming pattern hinting at a floor near $350.  

    Quantitative Valuation & Gravity:  
    • TWAP baseline for MU since 2020 is $75–$130; the current price of ~$850 represents a 570% premium over lifetime TWAP and ~100% above the fair value of $430.  
    • CAGR gravity model indicates a 10× surge from $70 in April 2025 to ~$833 in August 2026, with a 97% phase‑completion probability for mean reversion.  
    • Efficient Frontier positioning places MU in the high‑return, high‑volatility quadrant; the 20‑week, 100‑week, and 200‑week SMAs confirm an over‑extended trade with a gravity risk of 75% and risk level 8.  
    • Case study: the 3‑standard‑deviation maxeuphoria band ($700–$875) was breached in July 2024, followed by a sharp 50% drop from $132 to $1.70, illustrating the volatility of AI‑related stocks.  

    Target Floors & Trap Identifications:  
    • ML forecast targets a floor around $347–$350 based on a 10‑week bottoming pattern; panic drawdown floors are projected near $555–$695 (extreme bubble zone).  
    • Standard deviation bands: the 3‑σ maxeuphoria band ($700–$875) and the extreme bubble band ($555–$695) delineate euphoria overextensions; the fair‑value band ($439–$552) signals a potential mean‑reversion zone.  
    • Explicitly named traps: the “maxeuphoria” trap ($700–$875) and the “extreme bubble” trap ($555–$695) are highlighted; the 97% completion risk indicates a likely mean‑reversion pressure.  

---
